question_text:

\[\begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 2 \\ 5 \end{pmatrix} + t \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ a \\ 4 \end{pmatrix}\]and
\[\begin{pmatrix} -7 \\ -3 \\ 11 \end{pmatrix} + u \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 4 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}\]are perpendicular.

Return only the final boxed answer content as a concise mathematical expression.

Set the dot product to zero for perpendicularity:

$$
4a + 6 = 0 \implies a = -\frac{3}{2}
$$
